title: Finite realizability of a finance-extremal prefix forces a tax larger than packed-to-theta slack at L=25781
statement: Finance extremality plus finite realizability of near-extremal O/E prefixes at (L,o)=(25781,16266) produces an extra defect, not coming from another 1/(x log x) estimate, that exceeds the packed-to-theta slack in which one may lose 6532 of 6751 cheap OOE starts or deepen every OE, and that defect is not an archived first-block cell and not the false reading that local K caps the global cheap-OOE count.
counterexamples: 1000057 completes two packed/bunched OOE with prefix tax -2e-15
Treating local completed OOE as a global cap would lose 6749>6532 cheap starts; later valleys may restart OOE
deepen_all_still_above_theta is true, so even a ban on every two-type word stays inside slack
notes: Phase 0 only. No K<=20 proof, no inverse-width reopen, no branch-and-bound engine, no floor raise, no L=55293. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: Witnesses {365, 1000001, 1000057}; five near-extremal words at (25781,16266); slack from deficit_row
